dict.string: VibeCheck asks Finder to empty the Trash, only when you choose Empty Trash.
VibeCheck turns Bluetooth on or off when you use its Bluetooth button, and while your Mac sleeps if you switch that on in Settings.
VibeCheck reads the name of your Wi-Fi network to keep your Mac awake while you're on the network you chose in Settings. Your location is never used or stored.
